test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 40 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to the 24 percent of its selling price. What is the profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

40% × Cost price (C.P) = 24% × Selling price (S.P)

**Formula used:**

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit % = (profit × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

40% × C.P = 24% × S.P

⇒ C.P/S.P = 24/40 = 3/5

⇒ C.P : S.P = 3 : 5

Profit = S.P - C.P

⇒ 5 - 3 = 2 units

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P

⇒ (2 × 100)/3 = 66.66%

**∴ The correct answer is 66.66%.**
